'''CZ-83''' was a [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] research facility during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], similar to the moon [[CZ-198]]. After Czerka's financial troubles during the [[Galactic War]], scavengers began hauling away large amounts of outdated circuitry from CZ-83.<ref name="Shadow">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=crewskill|Scavenging|The Last One}}</ref>
